{{Quote|I tell you, Hobbie, nothing Dodonna said prepared me for the sight of all those ships. Commenor must be some major-league trading planet&hellip;Made me feel like a real rube from Tatooine.|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]|<ref name="Empire 12">[[Empire 12|''Empire'' 12]]</ref>}}
'''Commenor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], just outside of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==Description==
A trading outpost and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Commenor was considered as prestigious as the Core [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It was known for its [[chrysopaz]] gemstones and local [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]].

==History==
===Early history===
Commenor began as a colony of [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]]. Due to slow interstellar travel and communications, it was one of several colony [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that declared their independence. The planet joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Old Republic era===
During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] [[Battle of Commenor (Mandalorian Wars)|attacked the planet]] as part of the [[Mandalorian Triumph]] campaign. Between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]], a battle was [[Battle of Commenor (Jedi Civil War)|fought here]] against [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|the Sith]], which the Republic won.<ref name="TEA" /> Later, it was represented by [[Bevera Dodonna]] during [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the returning Sith Empire from [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas.]]

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], Commenor contributed [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and crew to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Outland Regions Security Force]].

[[File:Commenor.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Commenor with space traffic]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] spoke at the [[University of Commenor]] against the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]].<ref name="HNN45" /> The planet remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was [[Battle of Commenor (Clone Wars)|attacked]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Commenor native [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] became one of the first [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] captains, while [[Ahalas Svindren]] became a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a prominent Republic [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandist]].<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], there were a number of anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] protests across the planet.<ref name="DL:TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> A resistance movement later appeared on the planet.<ref name="FF88">{{FactFile|88|COM 1-2|Commenor}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established a [[Folor Base|secret base]] on Commenor's largest moon, Folor.<ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] undertook a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission]] to recover [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] from [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nera Dantels]]. The mission was a success, but pilot [[Cesi Eirriss]] was killed.<ref name="RS½" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. Commenor and nearby [[Foundry/Legends|Foundry]] were abandoned by Imperial forces in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], when [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces moved to the Colonies from the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Nevertheless, Commenor remained formally under Imperial control. After the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Bel Iblis]] designed an [[Operation Blue Plug|operation]] to conquer Commenor. However, the plan was never put into motion since the people of Commenor ousted the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] a short time later.<ref name="Exile" />

The planet remained independent from the New Republic, but still maintained trade relations with it, as well as with the Empire and the independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> By this time, the New Republic still used the Folor Base, especially during the [[Core Campaign]].<ref name="RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> The moon served as a New Republic stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]] and the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the Commenorian bioengineering corporation [[Xenovet]] had become a secret Imperial [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] plant. The facility was [[Mission to Commenor (9 ABY)|attacked]] by New Republic forces soon after the [[Thrawn campaign]]. There, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] freed former prisoners of the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and discovered that [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] had survived the [[Bacta War]].<ref name="IR" />

[[Tavion Axmis]] acquired the [[Scepter of Ragnos]] from a merchant on Commenor in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].

===Later history===
Commenor eventually joined the New Republic. [[Fyor Rodan]] served in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="DaD" /> during which time the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Commenor (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] the world.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> Commenor was later [[Battle of the Commenor system|liberated]] from the Vong by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Supercommando|Supercommandos]] at the [[29 ABY/Legends|end of the war]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Commenor became allied with [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] after the original plan to retake Commenor from the Empire was revised and leaked by an unknown party as a [[Chasin Document|plan]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] to invade and conquer Commenor. By that time, Fyor Rodan was its [[Prime Minister (Commenor)|Prime Minister]]. [[Matric Klauskin]] served it as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. It sent a fleet to repulse the [[Blockade of Corellia]].<ref name="Exile" /> Later, at the height of the war, Commenor contributed a fleet of Star Destroyers equipped with [[Long-range turbolaser|new turbolaser technology]] to the [[Confederation]] war effort.

It later came under [[Battle of Commenor (Second Galactic Civil War)|attack]]. During the attack, the Galactic Alliance Third Fleet launched an asteroid at the planet, and the Commenorians were unable to keep it from colliding with their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Commenor in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] of the Galactic Core.
